title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
summary: OpenAI 分享了在数学和理论计算机科学领域取得的十项进展，涵盖几何、密码学和复杂性理论等方向，解决了多个长期未解的开放问题。
highlights: OpenAI shares new results on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science
including advances in geometry, cryptography, and complexity
